# Spectre 0.3.0 Instance fixtures

The three JSON artifacts in this directory are immutable release evidence.
Compatibility changes must add a new versioned fixture; they must never
regenerate or replace these files.

`instance-v2.json` is the original empty revision-0 checkpoint emitted by the
released format-tagged version-2 writer and frozen in commit
`0fe257a9cbd602b3edb6d4ca3081ae9b764895b3`.

`instance-v2-advanced.json` was generated from the released `0.3.0` tag at
commit `456a8b75642130bb94c2839b2731f86b752d1188`. The generation scenario used
only that checkout's runtime APIs: it started
`SpectreCanonicalCheckpointCompatibilityFixture.Agent`, called
`Spectre.start_work/4` with
`SpectreCanonicalCheckpointCompatibilityFixture.WaitingWork`, waited for the
Work to reach `:waiting`, and read the checkpoint with
`Spectre.checkpoint/1`.

The committed artifact is 13,093 bytes including its trailing newline and has
SHA-256
`df82780db44d93011f3064e0132263396c6a1e2c1481d08e4419fc9cfe68bfe9`.
Its checkpoint revision is 2. UUIDs and timestamps are intentionally frozen
outputs from the 0.3.0 runtime, not regenerated by the compatibility test.

`reflective-runtime-v1.json` is byte-identical to the artifact committed in
the `0.3.0` tag at commit `456a8b75642130bb94c2839b2731f86b752d1188`.

The release suite pins the following exact bytes:
